frequency_question: What proportion of major federal agency rulemakings successfully complete the entire sequence from proposed rule publication to final rule publication within 272 days?
membership_rule: Includes all economically significant rules (impact over $100M) published as a notice of proposed rulemaking (NPRM) where the agency subsequently attempted to issue a final rule. Excludes interim final rules and direct final rules.

cases.name: EPA Mercury and Air Toxics Standards Reconsideration 2020

provenance_note: 6 cases named, 8 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.3x)
coverage_note: 8 named; believed representative of standard federal agency rule-finalization pacing under high-priority directives.
known_gaps: Excludes rules that were subject to immediate preliminary injunctions prior to publication of the final rule.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 8 sampled standard economically significant rulemakings that completed the full sequence within 9 months.
validity_reason: Based on Administrative Procedure Act statutory constraints which remain unchanged across administrations.
